candidate_relations.reason: Unchanged choline on MR spectroscopy and AQP4 titre 1:1000 with a long inflammatory history oppose brain metastasis.
Recurrent optic neuritis, LETM, persistently negative OCBs, and serum AQP4 1:1000 conflict with tumefactive multiple sclerosis.
Marburg variant is a fulminant MS subtype, incompatible with AQP4 seropositivity and a 23-year NMO-pattern course.
MRI describes a tumefactive T2 lesion without concentric rings of Baló sclerosis.
Inflammatory brain disease is a parent of neuromyelitis optica and omits AQP4-positive NMO specificity.
ADEM is typically monophasic, not four optic neuritis attacks plus LETM over decades with AQP4 antibodies.

case_quality_flags: AQP4 1:1000 with recurrent optic neuritis and LETM supports neuromyelitis optica, but no candidate names NMO/NMOSD.
